sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS events,CHECKSUM_AGG(BINARY_CHECKSUM(st.StockItemTransactionID,st.StockItemID,st.TransactionTypeID,st.TransactionOccurredWhen,st.Quantity,st.InvoiceID,st.PurchaseOrderID,st.LastEditedWhen)) AS checksum FROM Warehouse.StockItemTransactions st WHERE st.TransactionOccurredWhen < ?

SELECT st.StockItemTransactionID AS event_id,st.StockItemID AS item_id,st.TransactionTypeID AS type_id,st.TransactionOccurredWhen AS occurred_at,st.Quantity AS quantity,st.InvoiceID AS invoice_id,st.PurchaseOrderID AS purchase_order_id,st.CustomerID AS customer_id,st.SupplierID AS supplier_id,st.LastEditedWhen AS edited_at FROM Warehouse.StockItemTransactions st WHERE st.TransactionOccurredWhen < ? ORDER BY st.StockItemTransactionID

SELECT d.StockItemID AS item_id,d.UnitPackageID AS unit_package_id,d.OuterPackageID AS outer_package_id,d.QuantityPerOuter AS quantity_per_outer,d.ValidFrom AS valid_from,d.ValidTo AS valid_to FROM Warehouse.StockItems FOR SYSTEM_TIME ALL d WHERE d.ValidFrom < ? ORDER BY d.StockItemID,d.ValidFrom

SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS events,CHECKSUM_AGG(BINARY_CHECKSUM(st.StockItemTransactionID,st.StockItemID,st.TransactionTypeID,st.TransactionOccurredWhen,st.Quantity,st.InvoiceID,st.PurchaseOrderID,st.LastEditedWhen)) AS checksum FROM Warehouse.StockItemTransactions st WHERE st.TransactionOccurredWhen < ?
